title: CostSmith: tenant-aware prefill seed profiles and quantization autocalibrator
author: Liam Chen
description: Summary: Introduces a small, extensible service (CostSmith) that generates tenant-aware prefill seed profiles and an online quantization autocalibrator that recommends safe quant profiles per-tenant and per-workload. Motivation: many customers see large variance in unit economics across tenants; one-size-fits-all batching/quant defaults either waste budget or regress quality. CostSmith uses lightweight workload fingerprinting + conservative RL-inspired annealing to propose batch/cache/quant presets that respect latency SLOs and a user-configurable cost budget. This PR wires CostSmith into the optimizer pipeline, adds a simple CLI for on-demand seeding, and exposes a telemetry contract for future offline analysis. Key capabilities: 1) seed profile generator: samples recent traces, computes latency/cost shape signatures, and emits 3 candidate prefill/batch templates (conservative, balanced, aggressive) with safety bands; 2) quant autocalibrator: runs short microbench sequences using shadow variants (int8/4-bit candidates) and uses a loss+latency penalty to pick the highest-compression profile that passes quality thresholds; 3) tenant warmstart: persists best-known profile per-tenant and uses it as a warmstart for new workloads; 4) rollback guards: automatic canary and fallback to base model if steady-state token-level regression is detected; 5) CLI: costsmith seed --tenant <id> --budget <tokens-per-hour> and costsmith apply --dry-run; 6) integratation points: optimizer pipeline hooks, Redwood Console feature flag, and a telemetry schema. Checklist: - [x] design doc attached (Linear ENG-2201) - [x] unit tests for profile generator and quant comparator - [x] integration smoke test with optimizer pipeline - [x] telemetry schema registered - [x] feature-flag gating and docs stub - [x] e2e canary run in benchmark-lab (green) Related work: builds on PrefillSampler (ENG-1210), econ-autotuner prototypes, and the quant-sentinels experiments (see linked linear items). Commits (summary): - Add CostSmith core service and CLI scaffold - Implement seed profile generator and workload fingerprinting - Add quant autocalibrator harness and shadow runner - Persist tenant profiles in lightweight key-value store - Hook CostSmith into optimizer pipeline via policy registry - Add unit and integration tests - Register telemetry schema and add console feature toggle Files changed (high level): - services/costsmith/* (new): core service, CLI, tests - optimizer/policy_registry.py: hook to call CostSmith for fresh tenants - infra/kvstore/tenant_profiles.py (new): small persistence shim - telemetry/schemas/costsmith.yaml (new) - console/feature_flags.yaml: register feature - benchmark-lab/playbooks/costsmith-smoke.yaml (new) - docs/operators/costsmith.md (new) Review thread summary: - Asha Ghosh (reviewer): requested clearer SLO reasoning and suggested adding a percentile-based rollback trigger. Response: updated quant comparator to include 95th/99th latency buckets and added a configurable percentile rollback guard. - Marco Rivera (reviewer): asked for more conservative default budgets and explicit per-tenant opt-out. Response: added tenant opt-out flag and lowered default aggressive template budget by 30%. - QA (Rina Patel): reported flaky microbench in CI on AMD instances; we added platform-guard to skip that bench on AMD runners and extended retries. - Security (Jude Okafor): reviewed persistence shim; requested encryption-at-rest note added to docs. CI summary: - unit (linux): pass - unit (macos): pass - integration (benchmark-lab): pass - lint: pass - e2e (smoke): pass - perf-regression: amber (one tokenization variance); investigated and accepted as noise; perf job re-run passed Merge outcome: merged via squash on 2026-02-25 after two approvals. Migration notes: consumers of optimizer policy registry should expect optional callbacks; the CLI and feature flag are off by default. Backwards compatibility: no breaking API changes; tenant_profiles storage uses a new keyspace but that is additive. Rollout plan: feature-flag gated rollout to 10% tenants for 48h, then 50% after smoke metrics OK. Monitoring: new dashboards added under Console -> Cost Optimization -> CostSmith (tokens saved, candidate profile acceptance rate, rollback events).
